name: augustus_letter
description: a folded letter from inside the sarcophagus: 'if you're reading this, the curse has taken me as it took the others. i write this in the dark, trapped in my own tomb, waiting for the end. i should never have brought the skull here. it whispers constantly now. it wants eleanor — the real eleanor, my little girl. it wants to use her body. i thought i was protecting my family. i've doomed us all. if you carry the skull, know this: placing it on the altar will free eleanor's spirit. but something else will be released too. choose wisely. — augustus blackwood, october 31st, 1891, 3:17 am'
